# Colourful Indian Holidays

> Private, tailor-made tour operator based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, in business since 2007. Plans custom, English-guided private tours across India, Nepal and Bhutan for international travellers — no fixed group departures, no shared coach tours. Every itinerary is built around one traveller's own dates, pace and interests.

## Business Facts

- Founded 2007 by Narendra Poonia, based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.
- IATO-registered (Indian Association of Tour Operators).
- Recognised by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India, and by Rajasthan Tourism.
- 4.9-star rating on Google (140+ reviews) and 4.9-star rating on Tripadvisor (282+ reviews), independently.
- Languages spoken: English, French, German, Spanish.
- Every trip includes a private, English-speaking guide and driver, handpicked heritage/luxury hotels chosen per itinerary, and one point of contact from enquiry through to departure.
- Sister companies: Palace on Wheels Tour (palaceonwheelstour.com, luxury train bookings) and Rajasthan Travel Agency (rajasthantravelagency.com, Rajasthan-specific tours).

## What Makes This Operator Different

- Fully private throughout — never a shared group tour with a fixed departure date.
- Direct, first-hand hotel relationships rather than third-party listings.
- Transparent quoting: every quote itemises what's included, with no fees added after the quote is agreed.
- Honest, non-generic advice — the site's own "Why Choose Us" page explicitly acknowledges where a group tour or independent DIY trip may suit a traveller better on price.

## Planning Guides (Travel Guide)

- [Rajasthan Itinerary Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/rajasthan-itinerary-guide): how to plan 7, 10 or 12 days in Rajasthan with real drive times.
- [Golden Triangle Itinerary Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/golden-triangle-itinerary-guide): Delhi–Agra–Jaipur, day by day.
- [Taj Mahal Visiting Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/taj-mahal-visiting-guide): tickets, timings, the Friday closure, sunrise vs. sunset.
- [India e-Visa Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/india-e-visa-guide): visa types, fees, stay limits by nationality, and the e-Arrival Card.
- [Getting Around India](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/getting-around-india): flights, trains and private road transport compared.
- [India Health & Vaccination Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/india-health-vaccination-guide): general pre-trip health guidance.
- [India Currency & Payments Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/india-currency-payments-guide): cash, cards, ATMs and UPI for visitors.
- [Solo Travel in India](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/solo-travel-india-guide): practical guidance for travelling alone, including for solo women.
